subject: pclxs review fixes: SAVESPTR SV leak, xsub_fnptr header rename, PerlIO-encoding unrecorded, newCONSTSUB nits, $a/$b two-globals test
description:
From the 2026-07-26 review of the overnight grind (for the Opus/pclxs side):
1. MEDIUM — SV leak per SAVESPTR: pclxs_newsvsv returns refcnt 1 (src/sv.c:49); pclxs_save_sptr incs to 2 (src/gv.c:211-213); pclxs_gv_restore decs once (gv.c:249-250). Drop the extra pclxs_refcnt_inc (or add matching dec); consider a shim-SV live-count assertion so this class is testable (R9 blind spot: t/60-lifetime.t counts host handles, not shim SVs). One leak per XSUB call that binds a global — unbounded in a long-lived image.
2. MEDIUM — include/pclxs/pclxs_host.h:239 and :408 still call the XSUB token "xsub_fnptr"/"function pointer"; after ALIAS fix d15b0d4 the token is a per-name registration, and an ALIAS group hands N distinct tokens where it used to hand one pointer. Rename to xsub_token, reword both comments to say opaque per-registered-name.
3. LOW-MED — PerlIO-encoding moved api-gap→failed in 36f2414 with explanation only in the commit message; record in plan.md worklist (near HTML::Parser MGVTBL) and fix session-log §11 "one failed row" claim.
4. LOW — src/call.c newCONSTSUB: char full[512] silently truncates long qualified names; newCONSTSUB_flags ignores len and assumes NUL-termination (the one thing _flags exists not to assume).
5. LOW — t/89-gvsv.t binds only $_; add the $a/$b two-globals-at-once case (the reduce shape) per R28.
6. NEW (s314) — no conformance case exercises method_lookup's autoload_ok flag (gv_fetchmethod_autoload). PCL now implements it (closure that sets $PKG::AUTOLOAD at call time; DESTROY never AUTOLOADed) but nothing discriminates it — R28: add corpus cases for lookup-hits / lookup-misses-with-AUTOLOAD-in-@ISA / autoload_ok=0 / method DESTROY.
7. NEW (s314) — the magic vtable pair (magic_set/magic_get keyed on host identity) needed to fix the XS OO blocker: see pcl docs/xs-blessed-ref-referent-bug.md (rewritten) — the referent's shim struct is mortal and proxies are rebuilt per crossing, so sv_magicext state is lost between XSUB calls under EVERY host. Interlocks with MGVTBL free callback + DESTROY. Add a corpus case that attaches magic in one XSUB call and reads it in a later one (Digest::MD5's exact shape).
